description: Analytical original Kimi K2 geometry under uniform Q4_0 (4.5 effective bits), with FP32 routing-correction buffers. Full parameter count is derived from native geometry, not rounded to 1T. NOT a measured K2.7 result or supported model adapter. 7 GB/s and 0.25 seconds other work are hypothetical. Memory placement, headers/alignment and duplicate preparation storage are not evaluated.
